Ernest Howard Crosby, Captain Jinks, Hero.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ernest-howard-crosby/captain-jinks-hero

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ernest Howard Crosby, the author, died 1907 (Wikidata Q5393303, P570 = 1907-01-01 and 1907-01-03 in the facts file; the year is the same).

First publication of the text used: 1902 (SE colophon: 'Captain Jinks, Hero was published in 1902 by Ernest Howard Crosby.'). Wikipedia (Ernest Howard Crosby): the cover shown is of a 1902 New York publication of Captain Jinks, Hero.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition states the text is in the United States public domain (statement quoted below), and the text was first published in New York in 1902, before 1931.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States, before 1931, so the US rule settles the country of origin whatever the death year. Crosby died in 1907, and that date does not change the result.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published 1902 by Ernest Howard Crosby.
- Wikipedia, Ernest Howard Crosby: cover caption 'a 1902 New York publication of Captain Jinks, Hero'. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernest_Howard_Crosby
- Wikidata Q5393303 (Ernest Howard Crosby), P570 = 1907 (the facts file lists 1907-01-01 and 1907-01-03)
